As a Terminal Tractor & Warehouse Employee , you will have a varied combination role. Your work will mainly consist of moving trailers to and from the loading docks, parking trailers in the correct location on the premises, setting refrigeration units and checking the operation of tail lifts. You will work in shifts , with varying working hours. Working in the evening is also part of the schedule.
